conviction_note: Net of two opposing forces: the one finding below is worth about +2, and against it I put roughly -3 for things I did not raise to findings because they are plainly on the wire - six of eight reactions negative at a 10.81% median, a flat revenue guide, downgrades from BofA on 2026-06-25 (Underperform, PT $70) and JP Morgan on 2026-08-04 (Underweight), $250m+ of G-III litigation, and a new CFO whose start date falls in the print week, which is the classic setting for a guidance reset.

findings.finding: PVH's Calvin Klein women's dress and suit licences expire on 2026-12-31 after twenty years, returning that revenue in-house at PVH's own margin - a dated structural step-up in FY2027 revenue and gross margin that the pre-print coverage in this capture flags as overlooked, published two weeks before the print under the headline 'the deadline Wall Street forgot', against a stock at roughly 6.5x forward earnings with a 10.5% short float.
findings.corpus_ref: docs/766a040dcbb374969697a6e848bef94cdf917d67.txt (StockTwits sweep 20260830T083808Z), message of 2026-08-15T13:39:27Z, which also supplies the 6.5x forward earnings and 10.5% short float figures and states the bear case it is arguing against
findings.why_not_priced: Two houses downgraded this stock in the ten weeks before the print - BofA to Underperform with a $70 target on 2026-06-25 and JP Morgan to Underweight on 2026-08-04 - and neither, as relayed here, engages with a licence reversion that mechanically lifts owned-brand revenue and margin from the first day of 2027. The corpus contains no news document that discusses it either; the only place it appears in 151 captured items is one independent research relay. The stock meanwhile fell 16.97% over twenty sessions to $72.29, which is where the JP Morgan downgrade's own raised $84 target sits well above the price - an incoherence the corpus itself remarks on. The print is the natural forum for management to size the reversion into FY27, and a 10.5% short float is the fuel if they do. The band's low end is only -1 because this is a January-2027 economic event: it cannot make this quarter's numbers, so its worst case is simply that it goes unmentioned.
findings.independence: Pointing the other way from a different source in the same corpus, which is why my net number is negative rather than positive: https://www.pvh.com/news/press-releases/pvh-corp-appoints-alexis-rollier-as-chief-financial-officer (relayed 2026-07-14T20:47:49Z, and matching the 8-K item 5.02 at accession 0001213900-26-077971 accepted 2026-07-14T20:23:20Z) puts the new CFO's effective date in 'early September 2026', i.e. the print week. A second independent negative: https://everyticker.com/quote/PVH/analysis/pvh-s-brand-transformation-faces-its-first-real-test-nyse-pvh (2026-06-10).

baseline_tension: The finding cuts against the run-up (-7.92% over five days, -16.97% over twenty) and against the reaction history (six of eight down); my net number sides with the run-up and the history rather than with the finding, which is why it is -1.0 and not +2.0.
corpus_limits: No option chain or skew. No news documents were captured at all - the two stored bodies are both StockTwits blobs - so the licence-expiry claim, the 2026-12-31 date, the margin argument, the forward multiple and the short float are all one independent researcher's assertions relayed second-hand and I could not verify any of them against a PVH filing.
